name: seated single leg calf raise on a chair
description: A seated one-leg calf raise that mainly hits the soleus using only your body weight.
instructions: Sit on a chair with one foot flat on the floor, knee bent to 90 degrees.
Lift the other foot off the floor or tuck it behind.
Press through the ball of the working foot and raise your heel.
Pause at the top, then lower slowly.
Complete your reps, then switch legs.
